product.heading: The product
paragraphs: Tune-Up is a personal training log that turns raw workout entries into actionable weekly summaries. Instead of manually comparing spreadsheets, users open the app and see how this week compares to the last — volume, consistency, and progress across sessions.
bullets: Automatic weekly summaries and progress view
Mobile-first experience built for quick entry between sets

technical.heading: The tech
paragraphs: React Native and Expo in strict TypeScript, with a clean, layered architecture set as the priority from day one, so agents work inside clear boundaries instead of improvising structure.
Development runs on an automated agent pipeline built on Devin and Windsurf: shared project skills give every agent the same context, and each agent has one job.
bullets: Planner, builder and reviewer agents with explicit responsibilities
Project-level skills and rules as shared agent context
Cost-aware model selection: the right LLM for each task
Scheduled Hermes cron jobs that check repo issues, group them by category and implement the fixes on a new release branch

role.heading: My role
role.title: Solo mobile engineer
paragraphs: I own the project end to end: product definition, architecture, the agent workflow that builds it, and the release.
bullets: Architecture, data model and weekly-summary logic
Agent workflow design: skills, roles, model selection and scheduled jobs
